LanguageData.MooGirl_Armbinder.description: A slave restraint specifically designed to confine a Mugirl's hands, securing them together behind her back. When combined with specially designed slave gauntlets, even finger movement becomes impossible, rendering her completely helpless against any action taken against her. The restraint features a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with a [Rough Restraint Key].
LanguageData.MooGirl_Armbinder.label: Mugirl Armbinder Restraint

When combined with specially designed slave gauntlets, even finger movement becomes impossible, rendering her completely helpless against any action taken against her. The restraint features a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with a [Rough Restraint Key].

LanguageData.MooGirl_Handcuffs.description: A slave restraint specifically designed to confine a Mugirl's hands, using heavy shackles to secure them in front of her body. When combined with specially designed slave gauntlets, even finger movement becomes impossible, rendering her completely helpless against any action taken against her. The restraint features a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with a [Rough Restraint Key].
LanguageData.MooGirl_Handcuffs.label: Mugirl Handcuff Restraint
LanguageData.MooGirl_Slaveboots.description: A high-heeled boot-style restraint that limits movement speed. The wearer cannot remove them independently, though her gait appears to become more graceful. When combined with specially designed slave stockings, the restraint is further enhanced, rendering her completely helpless against any action taken against her. The restraint features a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with a [Rough Restraint Key].

LanguageData.MooGirl_Slaveshackles.description: Traditional heavy metal leg irons that significantly reduce movement speed. When combined with specially designed slave stockings, the restraint is further enhanced, rendering her completely helpless against any action taken against her. The restraint features a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with a [Rough Restraint Key].
LanguageData.MooGirl_Slaveshackles.label: Mugirl Slave Shackles
LanguageData.MooGirl_Straitjacket.description: A slave restraint specifically designed to confine a Mugirl. Though straitjackets were originally intended to restrain certain psychiatric patients, this version appears to have been specially tailored in several areas for Mugirls. When combined with specially designed slave gauntlets, even finger movement becomes impossible, leaving her unable to resist whatever is done to her. The restraint features a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with a [Rough Restraint Key].
